senses.definition: m. son of Ishmael Gn 25:15 = 1 Ch 1:30, cf. prob. Dûmath al-Jandal in Northern Arabia in Jôf v. BurckhardtTravels in Syria 662 f. Di; also Ges Comm. on Is 21:11, GlaserSkizze ii. 392, 440.

city in mountains of Judah Jos 15:52, comp. Δοῦμα in the Daroma, 17 miles from Eleutheropolis LagOnom. 250, 2nd ed. 258, = mod. Daume, SW. from Hebron vandeVeldeMemoir 308 Guérin Judée iii. 359 ff. cf. Di.

name of Edom with mystic meaning Is 21:11 Duma = silence of death, desolation, De Che al. (JDMich Ges Hi think 3 = 1; 𝔊 has Ἰδουμαια; Jerinterpr. as part of Idumea; still another view sub i. דּוּמָה).
